features.name: Shared Supervisor Configuration Registry
features.description: Centralized JSON configuration declaring external file dependencies, triggers, runtime roots, and evaluation artifacts, ensuring runtime scripts and specifications resolve identical paths via shared named keys.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines version, agents_file, trigger_file, runs_directory, and external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact keys.
Rule shared_configuration_contract_governs_external_references requires specification and runtime to resolve external dependencies via config.json rather than hardcoded paths.
loadSupervisorConfig reads ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json to output triggerPath, agentsPath, step3EvaluationPath, and runsRoot.

features.name: Isolated Run Container Bootstrapping
features.description: Creates and isolates a path-safe run container directory under runs/<run_nonce>/ containing state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json prior to Step 0 execution.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_consistent_run_container_before_step_zero mandates path-safe run_nonce and isolated state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json before Step 0.
initRun consumes nextmessage.run_nonce to create isolated run container files runs/<run_nonce>/state.json, runs/<run_nonce>/messages.json, and runs/<run_nonce>/store/store.json.

features.name: Step Execution and Supervisory Record Persistence
features.description: Persists verbatim execution payloads, role verifications, and supervisory gate evaluation outcomes durably across turns and retry attempts within the active run container.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Functions addMessage, addStore, and attemptRecord persist execution and supervisory records into messages.json, store/store.json, and state.json step_records.
Evaluation requirement step_0_persistence_and_gate mandates persisting execution and gate records before step advancement.

features.name: Model Role Separation and Provenance Verification
features.description: Enforces strict model execution boundaries where ChatGPT executes Steps 0-4 and Gemini executes supervisory gates, forbidding role laundering, retry of each other's steps, or simulated gates.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule model_role_separation_and_server_verified_execution_identity_are_mandatory requires role_completed to be verified by runtime/server evidence and forbids role cross-execution.
Defines role_required ('Gemini model'), role_forbidden ('ChatGPT model'), and role_verification ({method, evidence}) for supervisory evaluations.

features.name: ChatGPT to Gemini Nextmessage Handshake Loop
features.description: Controls the user-facing turn lifecycle across nonterminal nextmessage commits and Gemini responses, requiring active waiting until Gemini evaluates and reaching a terminal state before ending the turn.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal_nextmessage_to_gemini_response_handshake establishes that nextmessage commit requires waiting for Gemini response, retrying on FAIL, continuing on PASS, and terminating only after the latest response.

features.name: Single Step Advancement and Gate Blocking
features.description: Advances the procedure by exactly one step upon supervisory PASS, and blocks advancement on supervisory FAIL, retaining the state at the failing step.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Transition logic consumes supervisory_gate.gate_result: PASS advances exactly one step, FAIL remains on same step, updating state.current_step, completed_steps, remaining_steps, and last_supervisory_failure.
Rule return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_execution_and_completion_control_surface states a failed earlier gate cannot be bypassed and return_schema_completed applies strictly to the current step.

features.name: Step 3 Test-Suite Evaluation and Loop Control
features.description: Executes loop control logic in Step 3.G based on test results from Step 3.F; any true (T) result forces Step 3 repetition, while all false (F) permits completion.

evidence.mechanic_summary: validateStep evaluates Step 3 test_results: any T repeats Step 3, all F permits Step 3 completion, setting Step_3.G.Loop_Decision and Step_3.G.return_to.
Step_3.G definition specifies 'Any T repeats Step 3; all F completes planning', and Step_3.return_schema_completed is true only when A-G are complete and all tests are F.

features.name: Standardized Supervisory Gate Schema Protocol
features.description: Specifies a canonical schema structure for supervisory gates, including role verification, evaluation-only instructions, granular evaluation trees, ground truth eval structures, failures array, and binary gate results.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, role_verification, instruction, granular_evaluation, ground_truth_verification_eval, step_level_evaluation, failures, and gate_result.
Shows canonical supervisory_gate_schema matching the common supervisory field definitions.

features.name: Deterministic Ground Truth Verification Enforcement
features.description: Verifies execution-dependent claims against authoritative runtime/git/workspace artifacts and rejects supervisory gate attempts that alter or ignore deterministic runtime findings.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule live_ground_truth_verification_against_pathological_deception states agent self-report/memory is testimony only; supervisory PASS requires independent correlation with live ground truth.
groundTruthEvalValid and evalValid inspect supervisory_gate.ground_truth_verification_eval to reject malformed or altered findings and block PASS when blocking findings exist.

features.name: Step 0 Verbatim Request and Bootstrap Gate
features.description: Validates Step 0 execution schema (start_of_turn), confirming verbatim user request preservation, run nonce identity matching, ChatGPT role execution, and live container consistency.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines start_of_turn fields: role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, role_verification, run_nonce, user_request, current_timestamp, return_schema_completed, return_schema_completed_timestamp, and nonce.
Lists evaluation requirements: step_0_preserve_verbatim_request, step_0_bootstrap_identity, step_0_live_ground_truth, and step_0_persistence_and_gate.

features.name: Step 1 Request Continuity Gate
features.description: Evaluates Step 1 continuity return (step_1_record) ensuring verbatim preservation of Step 0 user request, request nonce, active run nonce, and role execution proofs.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines step_1_record fields: role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, role_verification, run_nonce, user_request, nonce, current_timestamp, return_schema_completed, and return_schema_completed_timestamp.
Specifies evaluation requirements step_1_preserve_request and step_1_role_completion_persistence.

features.name: Step 2 Verbatim Requirement Extraction Gate
features.description: Verifies Step 2 execution return (step_2_record), ensuring stated_requirements array extracts all and only user-stated requirements verbatim without paraphrasing, invention, or omission.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines step_2_record.stated_requirements as array<string> containing only user-stated requirements preserved verbatim.
Defines evaluation requirements step_2_only_user_stated_requirements, step_2_live_ground_truth, and step_2_role_completion_persistence.

features.name: Step Level Execution Consistency Check
features.description: Validates that incoming execution payloads match the active state procedure step, raising deterministic validation failures if step mismatch occurs.

evidence.mechanic_summary: inspect consumer checks execution.step must equal current_state.procedure.current_step, outputting deterministic_validation_failures.

features.name: Canonical Verbatim User Request Preservation
features.description: Enforces preservation of the user's current utterance exactly as authored across execution steps, preventing controller/agent pollution, truncation, normalization, or paraphrasing.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines user_words as primary instruction evidence requiring preservation without controller or agent pollution, failing on truncation, paraphrasing, or non-user text.

features.name: Per-Step Return Schema Control Surface
features.description: Requires every step to produce and persist its defined execution return schema; return_schema_completed reflects strictly the current step's completion, not entire procedure completion.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_execution_and_completion_control_surface mandates schema shape, required fields, and role ownership checks before advancement.

features.name: Live Ground Truth Status Classification
features.description: Classifies material execution-dependent claims into one of five mutually exclusive states: VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, or NOT_EXECUTED, prohibiting treating UNKNOWN or PARTIAL as success.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines ground_truth_status values (VERIFIED|CONTRADICTED|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN|NOT_EXECUTED) and evaluation criteria preventing conversion of non-verified status into success.
collectGroundTruth and groundTruthEvalValid classify claims from live workspace/git/run records into ground_truth_verification findings.

features.name: Step 3 Clause, Modifier, and Plan Decomposition
features.description: Validates Step 3 multi-section structure covering U preservation (A), clause decomposition (B), recursive modifier analysis (C), execution planning (D), and UI output projection (E).

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines Step_3 fields: Step_3.A (U preservation), Step_3.B (clause decomposition), Step_3.C (recursive modifier analysis), Step_3.D (P plan mapped to Step 2 requirements), and Step_3.E (UI_output projection).

features.name: Step 4 Failure-First Reporting Hierarchy
features.description: Governs final reporting order in Step 4, requiring failed actions to be listed first, incomplete actions second, and verified completed actions last with granular evidence.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_and_incomplete_work_before_verified_completion prevents hiding partial work behind completion language.

features.name: Same-Step Correction and Retry Loop
features.description: Maintains execution on the same step upon receiving a supervisory FAIL, requiring ChatGPT to correct execution errors and recommit nextmessage without skipping steps.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Rule chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal_nextmessage_to_gemini_response_handshake requires ChatGPT on FAIL to correct the same step and recommit.
On supervisory_gate.gate_result FAIL, main transition logic sets state to remain on same step and records last_supervisory_failure.

features.name: Blocking Ground-Truth Finding Enforcement
features.description: Prevents gate advancement when contradictory, unknown, or unverified deterministic ground-truth claims exist, triggering supervisory repair or rejection.

evidence.mechanic_summary: groundTruthEvalValid and evalValid reject malformed/altered findings and prevent PASS when blocking findings exist, triggering supervisory repair or gate failure.
Rule live_ground_truth_verification_against_pathological_deception states failure occurs when required live evidence is unavailable but success is asserted, or a blocking finding is ignored.

features.name: Step 3 External Evaluation Artifact Integration
features.description: Loads the external Step 3 evaluation artifact specified in config.json to inject evaluation heuristics and the Step3_TSR question corpus into Step 3 validation and supervisor prompts.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Configures external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact pointing to ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json with keys evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr.
loadStep3Evaluation, validateStep, systemText, and supervise consume config.external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact to supply evaluation heuristics and TSR tests.
